description: Sends a twelve-note scale to the Scale input of the Quant quantizer, as twelve polyphonic channels

params.text: Puts that note of the octave into the scale or takes it out; the root is the bottom button

outputs.text: Carries the twelve note buttons as twelve polyphonic channels, 0V for a note left out and 10V for one in

notes: this makes no sound and changes no pitch on its own; patch its output to the Scale input of a Quant, where the twelve channels take over that quantizer's note buttons
menu: Preset — lists fourteen scales under Factory presets: chromatic, the seven modes of the major scale, harmonic and melodic minor, major and minor pentatonic, blues and whole tone
